title: Prefer keeping a box relatively small in comparison with its containing view

statement.en: Prefer keeping a box relatively small compared with its containing view.
statement.ja: boxをcontaining viewと比べて比較的小さく保つことを優先する。

conditions: As a box approaches the containing view's size, grouping becomes less clear and other content can feel crowded.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Boxes experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるBoxesの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Consider using padding and alignment to communicate additional grouping within a box

statement.en: Consider using padding and alignment for additional grouping within a box.
statement.ja: box内の追加groupingにはpaddingとalignmentの使用を検討する。

conditions: Prefer padding and alignment over nested boxes when extra grouping is needed.
Nested borders can make an interface feel busy and constrained.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Boxes experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Provide a succinct introductory title if it helps clarify the box’s contents

statement.en: Provide a succinct introductory title when it helps clarify a box's contents.
statement.ja: boxの内容を明確にできる場合は簡潔なintroductory titleを提供する。

conditions: A title can explain the relationship among the contents.
A title can help VoiceOver users predict the content within the box.
